title: Local corrections to OpenStreetMap for the six counted west-Pune junctions
osm_snapshot: backend/data/osm/osm_index.db built from western-zone-latest.osm.pbf (OSM data timestamp 2026-11-01 21:21 UTC)
policy: Corrections are applied by TwinCity on top of the imported OSM roads when the simulation network is built; OpenStreetMap itself is never edited.
A correction is made only where OSM is contradicted by the survey and by an independent check (left-hand-traffic side rule, OSM tagging rules, the study's own description).
Each correction can be turned off (enabled: false here, or the whole layer from the Simulate panel); docs/PROPOSED_OSM_EDITS.md lists the matching OSM edits for a mapper to review.

actions.reverse: Reverse the way's direction of travel (geometry order), keeping it one-way.
actions.set_two_way: Make the way two-way with params.lanes_forward / lanes_backward lanes.
actions.set_oneway: Make the way one-way; params.reverse reverses it first.
actions.set_lanes: Set the lane count of a one-way way (params.lanes).
actions.set_roundabout: Mark the way as part of a roundabout's circulating carriageway.

evidence: OSM: both carriageways of Dange Chowk Road north-east of the junction (ways 614201109 and 614201110, 16 m apart, lanes=2 each) are oneway=yes towards Kasturi Chowk, so the arm has no way out.

Left-hand-traffic side rule (Motor Vehicles Act / Rules of the Road Regulations 1989, keep left): on a dual carriageway each carriageway has its opposite carriageway on its RIGHT. Measured with backend/observed/oneway_audit.py: the partner carriageway lies on this way's LEFT, so this way is drawn against its real direction; its partner passes the same test the right way round. Partner: way 614201110.

Survey turning counts (pune_west_2026.json, kasturi_chowk; NICMAR Table 3) carry traffic both into and out of this arm: approach N 1414 veh/h in, 1403 veh/h out (E right + S straight + W left); approach E 1904 veh/h in, 1611 veh/h out.

evidence: Way 761395844 is a two-node piece of the roundabout (junction=roundabout) tagged oneway=no; junction=roundabout implies one-way circulation (OSM wiki Tag:junction=roundabout).

The neighbouring ring pieces 1484133388 (ends at the 32 degree node) and 1484133387 (starts at the 42 degree node) circulate clockwise, as roundabouts do in left-hand traffic; this piece is drawn from 42 to 32 degrees, i.e. against them, so the clockwise direction is its reverse.
corrections.proposed_osm_edit: Remove oneway=no from way 761395844 and reverse it so it runs clockwise with the rest of the ring.

evidence: Every oneway=yes carriageway of Shankar Kalate Nagar Road within 1.2 km of the junction is tagged lanes=4. On a one-way way OSM lanes counts the lanes in that direction (OSM wiki Key:lanes), which makes this an 8-lane road.
